scope: Display-only legend and imagery changes; no simulator, sensor, reward or agent-action changes

sources.type: Current cartographic background: Sentinel-2 at small scales and PNOA aerial orthophotos at larger scales
sources.retrieval: Browser viewport tiles only, with visible provider attribution; not bulk archived or a new prepared input bundle
sources.local_data_check: Existing named PNOA TIFF found on disk is a DTM; other checked TIFFs are elevation, fuel, slope and masks. No verified local incident-aligned high-resolution RGB mosaic was identified.
sources.limitations: Source acquisition dates and ground sampling vary by location. This update does not pin a Malaga imagery date/resolution, reconstruct2021 imagery, provide live sensing, infer thermal conditions, or refine the500m simulation grid. Higher visual zoom cannot create finer simulation evidence.

display.alternative: OpenStreetMap street style; existing usage-policy constraints remain
display.terrain_overlay: Off by default; optional12% over imagery,38% over streets; opaque local terrain when remote basemaps are disabled
display.boundary_contrast: Light casing behind native domain and inner buffer lines
display.legend: Larger SVG symbols, matching shared map colours, separate labels for people, evacuation destinations, exposed people and responders; plain-language fire-age and boundary explanations
display.observation_privacy: Public counts use received sensor records only. Empty records are explicitly not proof of no fire. Evaluator-only heat/burned-ground explanations stay gated by the existing world overlay.
display.technical_readout: Cell coordinates/elevation/fuel and source details moved under a collapsed disclosure

validation.frontend_command: cd ui && npm test && npm run build
browser_checks: Aerial backdrop loaded successfully over the existing completed topo-dev-003 episode
Legend labels, larger matched symbols and no-fire-evidence caveat readable at the tested desktop viewport
Street style selectable; remote-basemap disable exposes local pinned terrain
No reset, commit, inference, training or live dispatch was performed for these visual checks
validation.limits: Interactive visual smoke plus frontend tests; not a new simulation calibration or policy evaluation
